resources.string: Long-press power on anything. One long buzz means it looks machine made, two short means nothing points to AI, three quick taps means it couldn\'t tell. Press again on the same thing to say we got it wrong. Nothing is saved: your screenshot is checked in memory and only a fingerprint is kept.

This is “nothing points to AI”: two short.
